{{Top|leg}}
The '''Advanced blowtorch''' was an industrial tool that doubled as an improvised [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-mounted weapon, inflicting heat damage in the immediate vicinity of the droid. This weapon was more damaging than the basic [[Blowtorch/Legends|blowtorch]] due to its [[hydrocarbon]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] closely resembling military-grade incendiaries rather than the more common acetylene.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
